### fs.createWriteStream(path[, options])

Source: https://github.com/nodejs/node/blob/main/doc/api/fs.md

Creates a writable stream to a file at the specified path. The options object allows configuring flags, encoding, file descriptor, autoClose, emitClose, start position, custom fs implementation, AbortSignal, highWaterMark, flush, and windowsHandle. Returns an fs.WriteStream instance.

```APIDOC
## fs.createWriteStream(path[, options])

### Description
Creates a writable stream to a file at the specified path. The options object allows configuring flags, encoding, file descriptor, autoClose, emitClose, start position, custom fs implementation, AbortSignal, highWaterMark, flush, and windowsHandle. Returns an fs.WriteStream instance.

### Method
fs.createWriteStream

### Parameters
#### Path Parameters
- **path** (string|Buffer|URL) - Required - The file path to write to.

#### Options Parameters
- **flags** (string) - Optional - See support of file system flags. Default: 'w'.
- **encoding** (string) - Optional - Default: 'utf8'.
- **fd** (integer|FileHandle) - Optional - Default: null.
- **mode** (integer) - Optional - Default: 0o666.
- **autoClose** (boolean) - Optional - Default: true.
- **emitClose** (boolean) - Optional - Default: true.
- **start** (integer) - Optional - Position to start writing.
- **fs** (Object|null) - Optional - Default: null.
- **signal** (AbortSignal|null) - Optional - Default: null.
- **highWaterMark** (number) - Optional - Default: See stream.getDefaultHighWaterMark().
- **flush** (boolean) - Optional - If true, the underlying file descriptor is flushed prior to closing it. Default: false.
- **windowsHandle** (bigint) - Optional - A raw Win32 HANDLE value to write to, in place of fd. Windows only. Default: null.

### Returns
- **fs.WriteStream** - A writable stream for the file.

### Example
```javascript
const fs = require('fs');
const stream = fs.createWriteStream('output.txt', { flags: 'a' });
stream.write('Hello, world!\n');
stream.end();
```
```

--------------------------------

### filehandle.createReadStream([options])

Source: https://github.com/nodejs/node/blob/main/doc/api/fs.md

Creates a ReadStream for reading from the file. Options can specify encoding, autoClose, emitClose, start, end, highWaterMark, and signal.

```APIDOC
## filehandle.createReadStream([options])

### Description
Creates a ReadStream for reading from the file. Options can specify encoding, autoClose, emitClose, start, end, highWaterMark, and signal.

### Method
filehandle.createReadStream

### Parameters
#### Options
- **encoding** (string) - Optional - Default: null
- **autoClose** (boolean) - Optional - Default: true
- **emitClose** (boolean) - Optional - Default: true
- **start** (integer) - Optional - Start position in bytes
- **end** (integer) - Optional - Default: Infinity - End position in bytes (inclusive)
- **highWaterMark** (integer) - Optional - Default: 64 * 1024
- **signal** (AbortSignal|undefined) - Optional - Default: undefined

### Returns
{fs.ReadStream}

### Example
```mjs
import { open } from 'node:fs/promises';

const fd = await open('sample.txt');
fd.createReadStream({ start: 90, end: 99 });
```
```

--------------------------------

### filehandle.createWriteStream([options])

Source: https://github.com/nodejs/node/blob/main/doc/api/fs.md

Creates a WriteStream for writing to the file. Options can specify encoding, autoClose, emitClose, start, highWaterMark, and flush.

```APIDOC
## filehandle.createWriteStream([options])

### Description
Creates a WriteStream for writing to the file. Options can specify encoding, autoClose, emitClose, start, highWaterMark, and flush.

### Method
filehandle.createWriteStream

### Parameters
#### Options
- **encoding** (string) - Optional - Default: 'utf8'
- **autoClose** (boolean) - Optional - Default: true
- **emitClose** (boolean) - Optional - Default: true
- **start** (integer) - Optional - Start position in bytes
- **highWaterMark** (number) - Optional - Default: See stream.getDefaultHighWaterMark()
- **flush** (boolean) - Optional - Default: false - If true, flush the underlying file descriptor before closing

### Returns
{fs.WriteStream}
```

--------------------------------

### pipeline(...streams[, options])

Source: https://github.com/nodejs/node/blob/main/doc/api/stream.md

Pipes between streams and async generators, forwarding errors and properly cleaning up resources. Supports AbortSignal for early cancellation.

```APIDOC
### `pipeline(...streams[, options])`

#### Description
Pipes streams and async generators together, returning a Promise that resolves when the pipeline is complete. Handles error propagation and resource cleanup. Supports aborting via `AbortSignal`.

#### Parameters
- `...streams` (Stream | AsyncIterable | Iterable | Function) - Required - A sequence of readable, transform/async generator, and writable streams.
- `options` (Object) - Optional - Configuration options.
  - `signal` (AbortSignal) - Optional - An `AbortSignal` to cancel the pipeline.

#### Returns
- (Promise) - Fulfills when the pipeline has completed successfully or rejects on error/abort.

#### Example
```mjs
import { pipeline } from 'node:stream/promises';
import { createReadStream, createWriteStream } from 'node:fs';
import { createGzip } from 'node:zlib';

const ac = new AbortController();
const { signal } = ac;

await pipeline(
  createReadStream('archive.tar'),
  createGzip(),
  createWriteStream('archive.tar.gz'),
  { signal },
);
```
```

--------------------------------

### stream.finished(stream[, options])

Source: https://github.com/nodejs/node/blob/main/doc/api/stream.md

Returns a Promise that fulfills when the stream is no longer readable or writable, or has experienced an error or a premature close event.

```APIDOC
### `stream.finished(stream[, options])`

#### Description
A promise-based function that fulfills when the stream is no longer readable or writable.

#### Parameters
- `stream` (Stream | ReadableStream | WritableStream) - Required - A readable and/or writable stream/webstream.
- `options` (Object) - Optional
  - `error` (boolean) - Optional
  - `readable` (boolean) - Optional
  - `writable` (boolean) - Optional
  - `signal` (AbortSignal) - Optional - An `AbortSignal` to abort waiting for the stream to finish.
  - `cleanup` (boolean) - Optional - If `true`, removes the listeners registered by this function before the promise is fulfilled. Default: `false`.

#### Returns
- (Promise) - Fulfills when the stream is done reading/writing.

#### Example
```mjs
import { finished } from 'node:stream/promises';
import { createReadStream } from 'node:fs';

const rs = createReadStream('archive.tar');

async function run() {
  await finished(rs, { cleanup: true });
  console.log('Stream is done reading.');
}

run().catch(console.error);
rs.resume();
```
```
